name: MOCA Teen Program (paid)
org: The Museum of Contemporary Art, Los Angeles (MOCA)
what_you_do: Teens work with local artists and museum staff, plan and run MOCA Teen Night, and manage the Teens social media account. The group meets at MOCA on Thursday nights and some weekends.
who_can_apply: High school juniors and seniors. MOCA aims for a group with different school, area and arts-access backgrounds.
pay_detail: Teens are paid. The page does not give an amount.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-27 are closed (over 130 applied). The next window is not posted.
how_to_apply: Not open now. See mocateens.org and the MOCA Teens page for the next call.
notes: Competitive. Check the page in summer for the next cycle.
